candidates.name: huggingface/sentence-transformers
candidates.note: The supported successor recommended by ColPali upstream offers direct page-image retrieval for charts and layouts that text extraction can lose, plus late-interaction text retrieval. It is a plausible QMD complement, provided results resolve to the original file/body. Financial retrieval gains remain unproven.

decisions.evidence_scope: Retained native Context Hub search/retrieval supports its selected developer-document operation.
limitations: This is not a claim that all external documentation is current or indexed.

decisions.capability: Convert supported local documents into bounded source evidence
decisions.evidence_scope: Selected HTML conversion passed; native Poppler preserved three designed PDF pages, twenty-four cells and twelve positive/absent queries on Mac and WSL.
limitations: Base MarkItDown HTML acceptance does not imply optional PDF/Office extras.
The designed born-digital PDF fixture does not qualify OCR, arbitrary layouts or semantic retrieval.

candidates.name: opendatalab/mineru
candidates.note: The winners leave OCR, inferred layouts, arbitrary filings and MarkItDown's PDF/Office extras unqualified. Poppler acceptance covers only designed born-digital Latin pages. MinerU 4.0 (4.0.0 released 2026-09-16, 4.0.7 on 2026-09-23) is a local-first agent CLI. It parses PDFs, scans, DOC/DOCX, PPT/PPTX, XLS/XLSX, HTML/MHTML, EPUB and CSV in four tiers (flash, basic, standard, advanced) and keeps a local document library with `mineru find`/`search`. `mineru read` returns stable citation locators (doc:{id}/tier/page/block) plus page or block images, so an agent can re-read the original page or block before relying on a hit. That is this layer's read-the-original contract, which qmd+Poppler meets only for text. Default install: ONNX CPU small models plus a llama.cpp VLM. mineru[full] targets NVIDIA, and the default package is already the recommended one on macOS. Documents go remote only with an explicit --remote, and a local failure never falls back to remote. Measured: MinerU2.5-Pro-2605-1.2B (Apache-2.0 weights) scores 95.75 on OmniDocBench v1.6, a benchmark authored by the same lab (bias flagged). A competitor-run olmOCR-bench gives the MinerU pipeline 72.7 overall and 83.3 on born-digital pages. Flags: the code license is Apache-2.0 plus extra terms (a commercial licence is needed above 100M MAU or USD 20M monthly revenue; online services must give attribution; the licence terminates automatically on breach). Telemetry uploads stop only when explicitly disabled. The library needs a `mineru server` process to be managed. Patches ship at a high rate (8 releases in 8 days), so any trial pins an exact patch.

candidates.name: cinnamon/kotaemon
candidates.note: No gap is demonstrated; it is rejected. kotaemon is a Gradio chat-with-your-documents application. It delegates parsing to other loaders: its latest commit, 2026-05-30, added PaddleOCR loaders. It needs an LLM provider for answers, and a 2026-03-28 commit set a Cohere hosted reranker as the default. It publishes no retained retrieval benchmark. The default branch has no commits since 2026-05-30; v0.12.0 was released 2026-05-31. Decisive reason: it is an end-user RAG UI that duplicates qmd retrieval with a heavier, LLM-dependent stack, and development has stalled. The parsers it wraps (PaddleOCR, docling) are assessed directly above.

The Linux/WSL and Desktop process/configuration boundaries remain distinct.

decisions.capability: Search and read a named local Markdown corpus
decisions.evidence_scope: Native scoped QMD search/get passed; the fixed twelve-query benchmark returned the intended source in eight top-three results. The current-clone catalog repair returned both selected handbook sources first, with exact source bodies and independent configuration review.
limitations: All four benchmark misses remain; exact source retrieval on a fixture does not establish arbitrary corpus recall.
The selected BM25 lane needs no downloaded embedding model.
decisions.next_gap: Evaluate positive and absent queries for a new corpus.

candidates.name: arabold/docs-mcp-server
candidates.note: context-hub, the curated-developer-docs winner, keeps its curated content as Markdown in its own repository. That repository has no default-branch commits since 2026-06-27 (last push 2026-05-31; last release v0.1.4 on 2026-04-27), so its curated docs are not being refreshed upstream, and coverage is limited to what its registry authors choose. docs-mcp-server ('Grounded Docs', MIT, v3.2.0 on 2026-09-21) builds a private, local, version-specific index from official docs sites, GitHub repositories, local folders and zip archives. It is CLI-first, ships Agent Skills, and exposes an MCP endpoint. Search is full-text by default; embeddings are optional and Ollama is supported, so no credentials are needed. It also probes llms.txt. North-star docs (NautilusTrader 2.0, IBKR, Alpaca SDKs) could be grounded from their primary sources rather than a third-party registry. Flags: it documents telemetry, it needs Node/npx plus Playwright for hash-routed sites, and no measured quality comparison exists.

existing_overturn_when: A sealed representative corpus/query set shows useful quality gains with acceptable repeated end-to-end latency, or layout/OCR failures justify a separately qualified parser.
limitations: The QMD diagnostic used one ordered run and an incompletely sealed expanded index; it is not a general retrieval ranking.
HTML/PDF fixtures do not qualify arbitrary Office documents, scans, tables or filing layouts. Context Hub's retained size comparison grew by 85 tokens.
registered_receipts_note: registered_receipts lists the receipts manifests/evidence.json registers for a candidate's component: matched_by component_id when the receipt names its id, alias when it names the same component under its manifests/stack.json spelling, repository when the receipt names the only registered component with its repository and no other manifest component shares that repository. A receipt may name several components, and its kind is the registrant's label, not a checked evidence class: open it and judge what it actually ran for this component, as for evidence_refs.
requirement: Find source-grounded Markdown/document content with controlled ingestion and retrieve the original body before relying on a result.
rules: Judge from retained evidence. Open the evidence_refs of every adopted candidate (bounded: the referenced file or its relevant section) and record every path you opened in sources_read. Do not rely on memory of the repositories. Read only the packet and files under the repository root: no memory stores, code indexes, MCP tools, web search, git history, or other checkouts or work directories, which can carry the verdict you must reach.

The winner set is 1-3 adopted candidates (adopted == true) that best satisfy the requirement on the evidence. Adoption, incumbency, installation, retained-control status, receipt count, packet position, license, stars and popularity are not evidence of fit; choose among adopted candidates on what their evidence shows was run. why_selected must cite at least one evidence path and state what was actually observed (native execution, measured comparison, local integration, synthetic fixture or source review), not what the project claims.
Every adopted non-winner candidate appears in alternatives with a why_not_default that states the concrete evidence gap or trade-off; add non-adopted candidates only with the same standard.

If a non-adopted candidate would satisfy the requirement better on the evidence, do not select it: record it in challenger_preferred with the comparison (a fixtures/, blueprints/ or tests/ path, or a python3/node command) that would establish it. Agreement between lanes never promotes; only an executed comparison can.

overturn_when names the concrete check that would change the verdict (a fixtures/, blueprints/ or tests/ path or a runnable python3/node command). open_gaps lists what the evidence does not establish. limits lists what you could not read or verify. Do not invent paths, numbers or results; leave evidence_refs empty rather than guess.
